newsitem.title: USA: Dow soars more than 50 points near close.
newsitem.headline: Dow soars more than 50 points near close.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average surged more than 50 points in the last minutes of trading Friday, bolstered by strength in high-technology stocks.

According to early, unofficial figures, the 30-share Dow jumped 53.29 points to 6,471.76. In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by about a 3-2 margin on very heavy volume of about 528 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
